newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish May core inflation up 0.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Finnish May core inflation up 0.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Finnish core inflation was 0.5 percent year-on-year in May and 0.3 on April, Statistics Finland said in a statement on Tuesday.
The mean of six economists' forecast for the May core inflation had been a 0.4 percent rise in a 0.3-0.5 percent range.
The Bank of Finland's target for the year-on-year change in the underlying rate of inflation -- its chief gauge for monetary policy -- is a rise of no more than around two percent.
